findings.one_line: The proposal promised RankPeel on the unchanged PNHZ class without extra support regularity, but the usable headline result adds full-dimensional open-support/positive-density hypotheses and therefore proves a strict-subclass kernel instead.

The load-bearing negative result neither identifies a specific published PNHZ estimator/workflow that conditions on the all-version rank oracle nor supplies the required nondegenerate or open-class witness: its failure-driving pair has diagonal support X1=X2, so it records only a hand-tuned degeneracy (subfield ceiling) until repaired.

Position the strict-subclass quadratic schedule theorem against the closest PNHZ construction at theorem level (including its query/complexity guarantee or lack thereof), and give relevance sentences for the presently unpositioned Chen--Fang, Cattaneo--Feng--Shigida, and Dong et al. bibliography entries or remove them.
